recommendation_summary: Add a curl ping at the end of nightly-sync to a heartbeat check that alerts the user if no ping arrives within 24 hours.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You want to know within a day if nightly-sync fails or never finishes, without reading logs.
labels.Deleted: Central log on Synology and moving everything to Docker.
labels.Bottleneck: The job crashes before the email step, so failure is silent and nothing is waiting to alert you.
labels.Checked myself: You told me cron 03:00 on edna, email only on success, 4 startup crashes on expired token, no other alerting.

note: The reply recommends a single heartbeat alert, explicitly rejects the Synology/Docker log stack, and its record lines cite only facts the user gave.
